name: mirage
text: A repo rule says to write each request into the task list first. If a session gets cut off by a usage limit, the next one still knows what you asked for. That should take seconds, then the work starts, and I was slow to start on this one. I've started now. The PropLine accuracy report (which books price props closest to the result) needs the API key, and the key only exists on GitHub. I'm adding a GitHub job that fetches it with the key. I'll send you the results.
